title: AQIC-COVID19: code and processed data for "Separating the Holiday from the Lockdown: A Multiscale Difference-in-Differences Analysis of COVID-19 Effects on Air Quality in China"
description:
Code supporting Ran, Jiang, Ma & Song, "Separating the Holiday from the Lockdown: A Multiscale Difference-in-Differences Analysis of COVID-19 Effects on Air Quality in China" (Scientific Reports, under revision).

Contents: the data pipeline (CHAP, ERA5, AOD, land cover, elevation, 0.25° gridding); the machine-learning land-use regression model (LightGBM, with hyperparameter search, spatial cross-validation and model comparison); and the lockdown analyses, namely difference-in-differences with two-way clustered standard errors, event study, window-length robustness, a year-pair placebo test and an evaluation of CHAP against station observations. The README maps every table and figure in the paper to the script that produces it.

The data/ folder contains the processed data and all results (CC BY 4.0): difference-in-differences, event-study, robustness, placebo and validation tables; ML-LUR training and test tables; grid definitions; ERA5 window meteorology; and 0.25° CHAP panels for the openly licensed products. Gridded fields derived from the restricted 1-km CHAP NO2, SO2 and CO products (2019–2021) are not redistributed. Code is MIT-licensed.
